summary: frontend-orb ships an install-time dropper that fetches the Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated payload
details: frontend-orb@4.4.14 advertises itself as a CircleCI orb (source under src/ is YAML), but its package.json declares preinstall: node setup.mjs. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-obfuscated and, on npm install, downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a bundled 727KB obfuscated payload (math_init.js). math_init.js is likewise obfuscator.io-obfuscated (string-array rotation decoder, _0x... identifier renaming) and prefixed `// @bun @bun-cjs` so it runs only under the freshly downloaded Bun runtime, evading Node-based static analysis. The declared main entry (index.js) is absent from the tarball, so the package has no functional CI-orb library code; the only effect of installation is execution of the opaque payload under an alien runtime. Purpose mismatch, install-time dropper, alternate-runtime execution, and heavy obfuscation together match the alternate-runtime-dropper attack pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
